comments.body: @alanhorstmann, can you confirm this specimen. If confirmed, this is an introduced species to this area.

Tough one, with the neck folded down and the bold black eyestripe, but if you look closely at the upper right leg, the diagnostic chestnut thigh feathers of the GBH are apparently visible as a thin line. Plus the mechanism of how this sort of species might get across the Atlantic to VA makes Grey Heron an ID in need of excellent documentation. I suspect it is lighting and a hunkered down posture (note the folded down neck) that lead to the suggestion of Grey Heron.
